name: TxDOT Austin
text: TRAFFIC ALERT: NB/SB I-35 between Airport Blvd and 12th St, varying nightly lane closures, 10/12-10/15, 9pm-5am. Multiple entrance and exit ramps will be closed for paving work. Also, MLK bridge and NB/SB frontage roads will have varying nightly lane closures. #ATXtraffic #My35 pic.twitter.com/2H4q0X5ND4
